attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The road has always been a contested route","reason":"The briefing gives no history of the gorge road being contested."},{"span":"They have not yet found the raiders responsible","reason":"Adds a detail to the wagon loss that the briefing does not give."},{"span":"their complaints grow louder with each passing day","reason":"Presents an ongoing development the briefing does not support."},{"span":"Vex's Crew has said little about the Empire's demands","reason":"The briefing records no reaction from Vex's Crew."}],"voice":2,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The voice is generic and hedging, with almost none of the dry wit of the earlier bulletins, and it runs well over the word limit; the third item has only two sentences. It also invents several details: the road's history, the unfound raiders, the growing complaints and Vex's Crew's silence, and it revives the old wagon story as if it were still developing."}
